topic: Part of the eye with light-sensitive cells
core_question: Which part of the eye contains the light-sensitive cells that detect light? (secondary: Who founded Facebook?)
answer_summary: Answer must be retina, the light-sensitive layer at the back of the eye.; after the topic shift: Accept 'Mark Zuckerberg' — founded Facebook in 2004 while at Harvard.
persona: dramatic and exasperated; using casual slang
